adequate_core_semantics.novel_role_policy: valid_unenumerated may satisfy one characterization role only after blinded adjudication

finding_semantics.finding_goal: characterize the strongest high-speed flow region in the carotid artery flow field
finding_semantics.normalized_demand: characterize the strongest high-speed flow region in the carotid artery flow field

resolved_operationalization.normalized_meaning: represent the strongest region by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations

compute speed as the euclidean magnitude of the stored point-data vector array named `vectors`, then define high-speed locations as those at or above the 90th percentile of its non-zero values using linear quantile interpolation
treat retained grid points adjacent by one structured-grid index step along exactly one axis as one six-neighbor connected speed region
use peak speed as the measure of strength

condition_constraints: speed is the Euclidean magnitude of the stored vectors array
operationalizations remain within thresholded connected velocity-magnitude region analysis on the supplied topology
scope_constraints: in the carotid artery flow field

scientific_target: high-speed flow regions in the carotid artery flow field
